subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Diferenciar, na leitura de textos, vírgula, ponto e vírgula, dois-pontos e reconhecer, na leitura de textos, o efeito de sentido que decorre do uso de reticências, aspas, parênteses.

components.description_pt: Distinguir funções da vírgula, ponto e vírgula e dois-pontos dentro de um texto
components.description_en: Distinguish the functions of the comma, semicolon, and colon within a text
components.cc_component_description: Use a colon to introduce a quotation within a sentence

components.description_pt: Reconhecer efeito de sentido produzido por reticências em textos escritos
components.description_en: Recognize the effect on meaning produced by ellipses in written texts
components.cc_component_description: Use punctuation conventions correctly, including commas, semicolons, and ellipses, in writing

components.description_pt: Interpretar efeito de sentido produzido por aspas em textos escritos
components.description_en: Interpret the effect on meaning produced by quotation marks in written texts
components.cc_component_description: Use quotation marks to indicate direct speech or a quotation from a text

cc_matches.description: Demonstrate command of the conventions of standard English capitalization, punctuation, and spelling when writing.
Use commas and quotation marks to mark direct speech and quotations from a text.
Use a colon to introduce a list or quotation.
